formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the allowance of `spender` over the owner's POLS (AnyswapV4ERC20 on BSC) to exactly `value`, replacing any previous allowance (permit: allowance[target][spender] = value).
The allowance never decreases when `value` is type(uint256).max; any other value decreases as transferFrom spends it.
Uses the owner's current nonce, so any earlier unused permit signature becomes invalid.
The signature is valid only until `deadline` (require block.timestamp <= deadline).
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with the spender address, the maximum amount in POLS ("Unlimited" at 2^255 and above), the expiry date and the owner; the nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no test case, so no rendering of the amount, token or Unlimited message is checked.
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: "cases: 0 (no tx)" for Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline).
findings.fix: Add an EIP-712 test with a finite POLS amount and one with type(uint256).max that renders "Unlimited".

findings.title: Permit intent does not name the token, so the glance line says nothing about POLS or the spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens"; AnyswapV4ERC20.permit sets allowance[target][spender] = value for this token only.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Approve POLS spending".
